translations.answer: The original author excluded executor, controller, RT update thread, and RMW, and disabled two registry initialization, worker startup, and each cycle async publish in the overlay. The two hot threads disappeared, and the CPU usage dropped from ~13% to ~1%. This confirms the overhead localization in the environment, but no maintainer has confirmed or merged the fix. The author's patch will completely disable the observation topic, and the subscriber-count gate is still just a suggestion.
translations.applicability: Applicable to Jazzy/master + Docker/SBC environments; numerical values and patches cannot be directly extrapolated.
translations.credibility.rationale: The environment, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.
translations.details.attempts.0: No change in SingleThreadedExecutor, disabling controllers, or DDS tuning. The two hot threads disappeared after disabling two registry and async publish sites in the overlay.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Checked topic subscription count, `ps -T`, thread scheduling/CPU/wchan; A/B tested by switching executor, controllers, RMW, and using overlay to disable registry/publish sites.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: The author's local workaround completely disables introspection/statistics topics, and the recommended subscriber-count gate has not been implemented.
translations.details.environments.0: ROS 2 Jazzy, ros2_control 4.44.0-1noble; Ubuntu Noble 6.8; Docker x86_64; CycloneDDS and Fast DDS; master 2026-05-27 reproduced.
translations.details.limits.0: Only the original author reproduced it; no maintainer has responded to or merged Issue; specific CPU percentages cannot be extrapolated to other hosts.
translations.details.limits.1: Disabling registry removes observation capability, and the subscriber-count gate is still just an author's suggestion.
translations.details.outcomes.0: The `ros2_control_node` dropped from ~13% to ~1% after overlay A/B; container total CPU dropped from ~22% to ~9%.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why does controller_manager still consume ~13% single-core idle overhead when both statistics/introspection topics have zero subscriptions?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: If temporarily disabling introspection on real hardware, retain independent watchdog, fault state, and critical safety telemetry; CPU optimization cannot be made at the cost of safety observation.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The author's A/B test localized the overhead to two pal_statistics registry worker cycles per cycle; no maintainer has confirmed the root cause.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Two regular priority workers each consume ~5–7% CPU and ~2000 context switches/sec; RT update thread consumes ~0.1%.
translations.source.locator: ros2_control #3356 complete reproducer, thread exclusion, and overlay A/B; only comment is from a stale bot.
translations.source.title: Zero subscriptions to pal_statistics worker still consume small host CPU.
translations.title: Controller_manager still consumes significant CPU when statistics/introspection topics are zero-subscribed, how to confirm the overhead is from pal_statistics worker?
